_comment: The cross-family accounting model, machine-readable so the linter can
check the docs against it. This file DECLARES; it generates nothing --
a docs repo whose tables are codegen output makes every contributor
learn a build step and lets the generated copy drift from its source.
adapters = which CLI you drive. families = whose training produced the
output. They are not the same axis, and one adapter can serve several
families; the reviewer-pairing rule reads the FAMILY of the verified

codex.cli: codex (via its Claude Code companion plugin, or raw)

agy.note: two separate quota pools; the Claude pool is a legitimate cross-family reviewer for anything Claude did not write

opencode.note: free pool; catalogue changes, verify with `opencode models`

unknown.why: stealth models whose family is undisclosed by design; they might secretly share any family, so they can never SATISFY the cross-family rule -- fine as an additional pair of eyes, never the accounting leg
